stage: Research; offline discrimination then conditional local authority replay; no closed-loop prototype
cases: All unchanged 120 C1 episodes in preacquired_holdout_protocol.json; no resampling
exposure: Retrospective exploratory study. All 120 cases previously inspected; no claim of independent holdout or statistical coverage guarantee.
parameter_rationale: Single untuned design, not a fitted envelope: retain existing 150ms freshness and .3m/s jump diagnostic; .05m/s is an operational coherence tolerance (one tenth of robot speed limit), not a physical safety margin; 3 fresh clean differences for recovery; .05m position tolerance only for unique causal ID-rename matching, never collision geometry; missing timeout escalates unresolved status and never deletes actor.
precedence: STALE > OCCLUDED (unmatched previously seen IDs) > CHANGE_UNCERTAIN (cold, rename, reappearance, velocity jump, residual, set/version change, recovery) > STABLE_TRACK. Flags retained even under higher priority mode.
causality: Estimator receives only t, delivered source/receive epochs, source/set versions, track IDs and source states. No kind/category/seed/event list/truth identities/outcomes. Association and motion cannot in general be identified separately from this interface.
authority: Only STABLE permits existing exact-CV main/certificate admission. Other modes veto new exact-CV certificates/main replacement, but never revoke an otherwise valid owned backup solely due to planner rejection. Holding a backup object is distinct from execution authority; state/queue/frame/time/coverage/assumption checks remain required. No stale renewal. No new recovery search or new certificate family implemented.
replay_limits: Local conditional decisions on recorded measured states/immutable queues. Original admitted certificate labels are reused. Rejected/unlogged proposed backup safety and actual extra waiting are Unknown. Once a counterfactual command differs, later recorded states cannot count as a simulated policy outcome. Report prefix divergence and freeze proxy, never prevented collisions.
decision: Go-to-prototype only if both gates and formal validity support hold. Modify if discrimination works but reserve coverage/authority remains unsupported. Stop if no meaningful discrimination or only universal refusal. Do not tune parameters after evaluation. One minimal implementation audit permitted. No automatic prototype in this request.
